messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PROD-EDGE-LB-HEALTH (sev=critical). Trigger: >50% targets unhealthy on edge-lb-prod and spike of TLS handshake failures. PagerDuty incident: https://pagerduty.company/INC123456 — paging @emma (oncall).

PagerDuty: Incident PROD-EDGE-LB-HEALTH assigned to emma (oncall). Auto-escalation set at +5m.

emma (oncall): acked. I'm on it — landing into logs now. Can someone check recent cert rotations and target health? :eyes:

raj (netops): seeing 502/504 rate up from EU and APAC edge nodes. LB target group "tg-edge-prod" shows many targets Unhealthy (HTTP 502) and TLS errors in the proxy logs. DNS looks okay from Route53; TTL=60s.

lina (sre): pulling healthcheck logs from edge instances. Quick tail:
```
2026-03-15T02:10:12Z edge-proxy[pid:3421] tls: handshake failure: certificate verify failed (unknown CA)
2026-03-15T02:10:13Z upstream: 502 Bad Gateway
```

sam (eng-infra): I can confirm we had an automated cert rotate job run at 02:07 UTC on edge pool. Rotation finished ~02:09 UTC. Rolling back to previous cert would be fastest mitigation if chain is malformed.

maria (support): tickets pouring in from EU customers complaining about timeouts and 5xx. CS is triaging; high priority. Need ETA for mitigation to update customers.

emma (oncall): immediate plan: 1) take failing targets out of service (drain) 2) switch traffic to fallback LB pool (edge-fallback-prod) 3) rollback cert on listener if rollback needed. Raj / Sam - can you prepare the failover and cert rollback commands? I'll coordinate comms.

raj (netops): starting failover now — shifting 60% weight to edge-fallback-prod, keeping 40% to observe errors. Command:
```
# svc routing (internal tool)
svc route set-weight --service edge --region eu-west-1 --weight-map "primary=40,fallback=60"
```

lina (sre): removing unhealthy targets from LB target group to stop new connections hitting them. Doing graceful drain for active connections.

sam (eng-infra): preparing cert rollback. Confirming old cert ARN: arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:111:certificate/old-edge-cert. New cert ARN: arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:111:certificate/new-edge-cert. Will run:
```
aws elbv2 modify-listener --listener-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:...:listener/abc --certificates CertificateArn=arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:111:certificate/old-edge-cert
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: 6140012345 acknowledged by emma (oncall). Next escalation in 5m if not resolved.

emma (oncall): executing customer comms now (standby msg). ETA 15m for initial mitigation.

raj (netops): weight shift in progress, traffic now 60% -> edge-fallback-prod. Early metrics: traffic success rate in fallback looks green, latency normal. EU error rate down ~45% in the last 2m.

lina (sre): cert rollback started. Replacing listener certificate... applying.

sam (eng-infra): listener updated successfully. Rolling restart of proxy processes on edge pool to pick up cert chain.

lina (sre): after rollback and restart, TLS handshake failure logs dropped to near zero on the recovered hosts. Health checks returning 200.

maria (support): CS updated — initial mitigation deployed, asking customers to retry. Opening a follow-up ticket for impacted accounts.

emma (oncall): monitoring for 10m to ensure stability, then we'll cut all traffic back and restore normal weights. Any signs of cache/DNS propagation issues?

raj (netops): DNS caches are fine; Route53 had no change. Problem looks limited to the cert chain on the rotated cert. CDN edge cache may have held TLS sessions, recommending to wait one TTL window (~60s) post-rollback for full effect.

lina (sre): running healthcheck sweep across eu and apac. Patch result: 98% healthy across edge pools now. A few instances still draining — expected.

sam (eng-infra): I've disabled the automated cert-rotate job for the next rollout window and created a PR to add extra chain validation.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: Incident updated to "mitigated" by emma (oncall). Will keep incident open for postmortem.

emma (oncall): marking mitigated — traffic restored to primary (100%) after stable 8m. Root cause appears to be malformed cert chain in the automated rotate causing handshake_failure on some clients/proxies. Next steps: postmortem, blameless RCA, and blocker fixes (validation gate + revert plan runbook).

maria (support): sending proactive customer follow-up now with ETA for postmortem.

lina (sre): saving logs and timelines. I'll take lead on the writeup with sam for infra steps.

emma (oncall): incident resolved. Closing pagerduty incident and scheduling 1hr postmortem sync at 10:00 UTC. Thanks all for rapid response. :tada:

PagerDuty: Incident PROD-EDGE-LB-HEALTH resolved by emma (oncall).

emma (oncall): quick after-action notes:
- Duration: ~35m from page to resolution
- Impact: increased 5xx and TLS handshake failures primarily in EU/APAC, customer-facing timeouts.
- Mitigation: traffic weight shift -> fallback pool, rollback cert, restart proxies
- Action items: add chain-validation to cert-rotate job, add canary step for cert rollouts, document rollback runbook, coordinated customer comms template.

lina (sre): filing the postmortem draft in #incidents-postmortems and tagging folks.

emma (oncall): thanks team. I'll drop final incident summary in the morning.
